instruction: Configure Chrome to restore the last session automatically when it starts, so you don't lose your open tabs.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting restore_on_startup to 1 (restore last session). Value 1 = restore, 5 = open specific pages, 4 = open new tab page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the Chrome restore_on_startup setting requirement
Getter logic correctly extracts session.restore_on_startup from Chrome Preferences file with OS-specific path handling
Metric correctly compares setting value against expected value of 1 (restore last session)
Expected parameter handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule(), not wrapped
Postconfig appropriately kills and restarts Chrome to verify setting persistence
Complete coverage - all instruction requirements are verified
Minor robustness concern: getter returns default value 1 on error, which could mask configuration failures, but this is acceptable defensive programming
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider logging a warning or returning a different indicator when setting extraction fails, to distinguish between 'setting is 1' vs 'failed to read setting, defaulting to 1'
Could add validation that the Preferences file exists before attempting to parse it
